defect: The commit replaced the (already invalid) constexpr string with an 'inline static const string DEFAULT_CA_CERT_FILE' in httpfs.hpp and used it in ReadFrom, a C++17-only inline variable that breaks builds below C++17.
reason: The fix removes the inline static member and initializes ca_cert_file with an empty literal, repairing the C++17 dependence this commit added; the inline keyword is only visible in the header part of the commit.

defect: The format commit changed make_unique<LogicalEmptyResult>(move(op)) to make_unique_base<LogicalEmptyResult>(move(op)), but make_unique_base needs two template arguments (base and derived), so the file no longer compiles.
reason: The fix titled 'Fix compilation bug' reverts exactly this line one day later, and the neighbouring unchanged make_unique calls show the inconsistency in the diff.

defect: BindFunction now returns a BindResult error instead of throwing when the scalar function fails to bind, after the children expressions were already moved out, so a caller that retries binding (correlated subquery at another depth) re-binds with null children and crashes.
reason: The fix for issue 3351 (null pointer in function binding inside a subquery) restores the throw and adds D_ASSERT(child.expr), undoing exactly the line this commit changed; seeing the retry needs the caller.

defect: The fix adds the new catalog argument to the CreateTPCHSchema and LoadTPCHData calls after a separate commit added catalog support to dbgen.
reason: The children/step call matched the dbgen signature at this commit; the later change only adapts the call to an API extended by another commit.

defect: The new AllNewLine helper returns true for an empty value, so the final empty value of a single-column CSV (a NULL row, e.g. an empty quoted value at EOF) is silently dropped instead of added.
reason: The fix makes AllNewLine return false for an empty value when there is one column, repairing the loss caused by the helper and its use introduced here; before this commit the value was always added.

defect: The fix counts only non-NULL tuples (via statistics) as qualifying when pruning row groups for a top-N limit, instead of the full row-group count.
reason: The previous algorithm also counted every tuple of a row group (seen_tuples += count) regardless of NULLs, so the NULL miscount was already present before this rewrite.

defect: The fix only formats the error message with GetError() when HasError() holds, because GetError() later gained D_ASSERT(HasError()).
reason: At this commit GetError() was identical to error.Message(); the assertion that made the unconditional call fail was added by a later commit (5063600), so this change introduced no defect.

defect: The fix writes 1u << 20 and 1u << 31 to silence implicit signed-conversion warnings on the constants.
reason: This is part of a warning cleanup series; 1 << 31 sign-extends to a different but equally unreachable map-size limit, so no behaviour changes.

defect: Next() now stops when file_handle.FinishedReading() reports requested_bytes >= file_size, but for compressed files file_size is the compressed size, so reading ends early and the remaining decompressed data is lost.
reason: The fix for compressed files drops the FinishedReading() early return and stops on a zero-byte read, repairing the check this commit introduced together with FinishedReading in csv_file_handle.hpp.

defect: The newly written DecompressValue reads byte_counts[i] bytes directly, but a byte count of 8 is stored as 0 in the 3-bit packed field, so values whose XOR needs 8 bytes decode wrongly.
reason: The fix maps byte_count 0 back to 8 (and handles equal values) in the decoder lines this commit added; the 3-bit packing that causes the wrap is in another file.

defect: The fix moves the header size inside AlignValue in HasEnoughSpace, drops the alignment in the unused RemainingSpace and replaces the literals 6 and 3 with the named bit-size constants.
reason: RequiredSpace reserves at least 49 bytes for an 8-byte value, so the up-to-4-byte alignment difference cannot make data reach the metadata; the change is a tidy-up with no observable defect repaired.

defect: The fix deletes the unused per_chunk_threshold constant from PhysicalIndexJoin.
reason: Removing an unused member is a cleanup, not a defect repair.

defect: The fix removes the list_reverse_sort and array_reverse_sort macros because they are reimplemented as native scalar functions honouring the configured default orders.
reason: Replacing the macros with native overloads after review feedback is a redesign, not a repair of a defect in the macros.

defect: The fix restructures list_sort binding (config default order and null order, two-argument and reverse-sort overloads, sort layout moved into bind data).
reason: The f557802 code had already been rewritten by intermediate commits; the later change is review-driven feature work and refactoring, not a repair of a defect in these lines.

defect: In this file the fix replaces the shredded Append path with an InternalException because appends to shredded variant columns can no longer happen.
reason: The commit message calls this removal of a dead code path; the actual consistency fix for issue 21352 is in variant_shredding.cpp.

defect: The fix comments out the TPC-H Q2 check and profiling print in the SF0.1 test again.
reason: This is a test change, not a repair of product code.

defect: The merge-conflict fix updates GetNewline to the split NewLineIdentifier values SINGLE_R and SINGLE_N.
reason: The enum was split on another branch; adapting the switch after the merge is not a defect of this change.

defect: The commit put Empty() only on StrpTimeFormat and changed the CSV writer to test the read date format's Empty() instead of whether a write dateformat was set, so COPY TO with dateformat/timestampformat ignored the write format.
reason: The fix moves Empty() to StrTimeFormat and makes copy_csv.cpp check write_date_format, repairing the write path this commit broke; the faulty check is in copy_csv.cpp.

defect: In this file the fix only reformats the EnumerateChildren lambda call.
reason: The format commit introduced no defect; the shown change is pure formatting.

defect: CSVComplexFilterPushdown builds its column map from data->options.names[get.column_ids[i]], but options.names lacks the filename and hive partition columns (and column_ids can point past it), so names are wrong or the index is out of bounds.
reason: The fix uses get.names instead and only runs the pruning when filename or hive columns are enabled, repairing the lookup this commit added; which names options.names holds needs the bind code.

defect: The fix caps FAST_TO_SLOW_THRESHOLD at STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE so sampling tests pass with vector size 2.
reason: The previous threshold 20 also exceeded a vector size of 2, so raising it to 60 did not create the problem; this is a tuning and test fix.

defect: The fix splits SetForeignKeyConstraint into Add and Drop so that adding a foreign key no longer removes the existing primary-key-side constraint for the same table pair (issue 4309).
reason: The loop that drops existing FK_TYPE_PRIMARY_KEY_TABLE constraints already existed before this commit, which only changed is_fk_add to the AlterForeignKeyType check.

defect: The fix corrects the delim_idx check in RemoveCandidate (it tested children[0] for FILTER and DELIM_GET at once) and rewrites FindCandidates with a join alias.
reason: The broken delim_idx expression was unchanged context, already present before this commit, and the FindCandidates refactor here is behaviour-preserving.

defect: The fix adds a dummy-scan and expression-scan child for in-out functions bound without children, so older serialized plans using range/generate_series still work.
reason: range/generate_series became in-out functions in an earlier commit (b84608e), and plans with no children already took the regular-scan path before this change, so the compatibility break was not introduced here.

defect: The fix makes Combine copy source.pos * sizeof(T) bytes at byte offset target->pos * sizeof(T) instead of using element counts as byte counts.
reason: The same faulty memcpy existed in median.cpp, which this commit moved into quantile.cpp, so the defect predates the change.

defect: The merge fix qualifies OnCommitAction with postgres:: after the merged code dropped the using-namespace postgres directive.
reason: The file compiled at this commit thanks to using namespace postgres; the break came from the merge.

defect: The fix drops the redundant '= nullptr' initializer of the optional_ptr stop_operator.
reason: optional_ptr is implicitly constructible from nullptr, so this is a style change; the real bug the fix addresses is in compressed_materialization.cpp.

defect: The fix compares stop_operator.get() == &op instead of stop_operator == &op after stop_operator became an optional_ptr.
reason: With the raw pointer of this commit, and with optional_ptr's operator==, the comparison was already correct; the change is cosmetic.

defect: The fix renames the enum value MILLENIUM to MILLENNIUM.
reason: This is a spelling rename of an identifier; the accepted SQL string and the behaviour are unchanged.

defect: The fix reformats the file (tabs instead of spaces, trailing newline).
reason: This is a formatting-only change.

defect: The fix pins explicit OptimizerType values to the 1.4 ordering and removes the generated enum_util mapping, as part of making MetricsType numbering backward compatible.
reason: Inserting ROW_GROUP_PRUNER mid-list was not a defect at the time; the numeric values had no stability guarantee until the later PR introduced explicit numbering.

defect: The fix assigns explicit numbers to every OptimizerType member and moves TOP_N_WINDOW_ELIMINATION to value 30 to match the 1.4 ordering for metric backward compatibility.
reason: Adding an enum member in the middle broke no functionality; the later commit sets up a new numbering policy rather than repairing a defect in this line.

defect: The fix only reformats the fallback ListFiles call (the opener argument had been added by another commit).
reason: The shown change is formatting by clang-format, not a defect repair.

defect: The merge fix renames MatchAndRepaceUserSetVariables, makes SetResultOptions const, raises the minimal-sniff result_size to STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE and ignores errors in the upgraded scanner.
reason: This commit only made result_size constexpr; the value 2 predates it, and the later changes adapt behaviour from a merged branch.

defect: The new loop that skips files whose scan is already done creates CSVFileScan for files[++cur_file_idx] with file index 0U, so later files get the wrong file index.
reason: The fix passes cur_file_idx instead of 0U in exactly the line this commit added; the mismatch with files[0]/0U in the first call is visible in the diff.

defect: MAP was given 64-bit offsets when arrow_offset_size is LARGE, but Arrow has no large map type and the schema still says map with 32-bit offsets, so the exported data is wrong.
reason: The fix always uses ArrowMapData<int32_t> for MAP, removing the large-offset branch this commit added.

defect: The warning fix computes static_cast<double>(source.count * target.count), a uint64 multiplication that overflows for large partial counts, and keeps the combined count as a double before assigning it to the uint64 field.
reason: The follow-up fix to these changes computes the count as uint64 and multiplies the double counts, removing the overflow the commit introduced; the integer product is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix marks NULL variant rows via the result validity mask instead of SetValue with a NULL Value, and skips rows already marked NULL, for the new ARRAY conversion.
reason: SetValue with a NULL Value already sets the row invalid, so the added NULL handling worked; the later change is an equivalent rewrite plus support for the new array path.

defect: The fix changes FindChildValues to take SelectionVector &res instead of const SelectionVector &res.
reason: SelectionVector::operator[] is const and returns a mutable reference, so writes through the const reference compiled and worked; this is const-correctness only.

defect: The fix creates the temp key on demand in the temporary-buffer encryption functions and removes a debug fixed nonce; in EncryptBlock it only moves a blank line.
reason: The repaired functions were added by later commits, and the only change to this commit's lines is whitespace.
